statement: A Ritual Monster cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. It must first be Ritual Summoned, from the hand, before it can be Special Summoned another way.

sources.where: Official Rulebook, version 10.0: Ritual Monsters, Ritual Summon
sources.says: A Ritual Monster is Special Summoned from the hand with a Ritual Spell Card and its Tributes; it is a monster that must first be Special Summoned its own way.

scripts: A reader of the scripts can't see it: ocgcore applies it to every Ritual Monster, and no script says it.
